🎄 Vlogmas Day 18 | Parker’s EPIC Christmas Room Tour, Roman Ruins in Valencia & Catan Junior Fun! 🎁✨

Welcome back to Vlogmas! Today’s episode is packed with creativity, history, and cozy family moments. 💚❤️

We start with Parker’s incredible Christmas room tour—he has turned his entire room into a handmade winter wonderland! He drew a giant light-up Christmas tree for his wall, hung garlands everywhere, made tons of paper snowflakes, and even wrapped his whole bed like a Christmas present. It’s festive, magical, and totally Parker.

Then Chris takes Rue out for a rainy walk and shows us some of the ancient Roman ruins hidden right in the center of Valencia. It’s such a beautiful reminder of the history surrounding our everyday life here. 🌧️🏛️

After that, the family gathers to open our advent calendars (a highlight every day!). And to finish the night, Chris, Duncan, Luke, and Teddy play a cozy round of Catan Junior—lots of laughs, lots of strategy, and lots of cute sibling moments.

🌧️ Vlogmas Day 17 | Rainy Day Walk with Rue, Advent Fun & Trying Spanish Candied Fruits! 🎄🍊

Welcome back to Vlogmas! Today’s vlog is all about embracing cozy rainy-day moments here in Valencia. ☔💛

Chris takes our dog Rue on a walk during a break in the rain and shares what wet weather really means for daily life in this walkable, outdoor-loving city. From parks and playgrounds to café terraces and long family strolls—so much of Valencia’s lifestyle happens outside, so rainy days definitely shake things up!

After the walk, we gather as a family to open our advent calendars (always a highlight!) before Chris and Bailey head out for a quick grocery run. While shopping, they discover some Spanish candied fruits and bring them home to try—so fun and SO different from the treats we’re used to!

Thanks for joining us for another cozy day of Vlogmas here in Spain. We love sharing this season with you. ❤️✨
